body:
As I reach out to grab my bag, I hear a soft voice from behind me in the apartment complex. "Is everything okay?" It's an elderly woman who seems lost or confused. I freeze, unsure how much longer I can hide.

I glance around frantically, looking for any escape routes or hiding spots. The smell of stale coffee and old books wafts through the open door, creating a surreal atmosphere.

Thinking fast, I whisper back, trying to sound normal but cautious, "Yeah, just checking if there's anything important I might've left behind." 

I step closer, eyeing the crates more closely. My heart races as I realize this isn't just another delivery; it's one meant for someone else entirely—someone who has moved on.
